title: Playing audio with AudioStreamPlayer on web by any means other than play() method ignores volume_db and pitch_scale
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in:
  - 4.7.dev1, 4.6.1-stable, 4.6-stable (all tests except for play() ignore pitch_scale on web. AnimationPlayer ignores volume_db too)
  - 4.5.1-stable, 4.4.1-stable (same as above, but AnimationPlayer also ignores volume_db and pitch_scale on desktop)
  - 4.3-stable (same as above, but AnimationPlayer ignores volume_db and pitch_scale on web, and only pitch_scale on desktop)
- Not reproducible in: 4.2.2-stable (before the Playback Type option was implemented)

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS (16 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory

### Issue description

On a web export, when playing a sound with an AudioStreamPlayer by any means other than directly using the play() method, the audio ignores the `volume_db` and `pitch_scale` properties. This includes:

- Autoplay
- Looping (in the MRP it starts ignoring after 3 loops, but I've seen it ignore after the first loop in other projects with longer sounds)
- AnimationPlayer audio track

The intended behavior is for the audio to always play with the `volume_db` and `pitch_scale` settings set by the AudioStreamPlayer.

This issue can be avoided by changing the `playback_type` on the AudioStreamPlayer to "Stream", which is not the default on web. I'm aware that the default Sample playback type has some limitations, however, the inconsistencies between Godot versions and ways of playing sound leads me to believe this is a bug rather than intended behavior. This is also not mentioned as a limitation in the documentation.

Live demo here: https://files.fupi.cat/fupicat/etc/web-audio-bugs/index.html

Tested on both Firefox and Chrome, same issue on both.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8705ab38-af02-469e-a9ab-edabeb0be204

### Steps to reproduce

Minimal reproduction (autoplay)
- Create an AudioStreamPlayer and load a stream.
- Set `autoplay` to `true`.
- Export to web and play the scene.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/fupicat/web-audio-bugs
